newsitem.title: PANAMA: Panama stock exchange volume up 59 pct vs yr ago.
newsitem.headline: Panama stock exchange volume up 59 pct vs yr ago.

text.p: Trading volume on Panama's stock market rose 59.46 percent during the first three quarters of this year up to September 30 compared with the same period in 1995, an exchange spokeswoman said.
The 11-share stock exchange traded $241.259 million in the first nine months, up from $151.298 million during the same period in 1995.
The jump is reflected in bolsa-listed companies making larger volume listings of bond issues and short-term commercial paper, the spokeswoman said.
